Push, pull, lint and compare programs

Usage:
  kaab programs [command]

Available Commands:
  alias       Point a program's aliases at versions
  diff        Print the JSON Patch from version V1 to version V2
  lint        Lint a definition; exit 1 when it has errors
  list        List programs
  pull        Print (or save) a program version's definition
  push        Create the program a definition file names, or add a version to it

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for programs

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)

Use "kaab programs [command] --help" for more information about a command.
